body: CHANGELOG updated in TYLER: feat(episodes): x06 'The Press Conference That Never Happened' — fifth GPT-2 render, second full episode, seeded from x05's own emergent line. Episode treats this explicitly as a real finding, not a bit -- the crew's in-scene reaction is professional alarm about AI-generated content that reads as authoritative on a real, sensitive subject, and the episode's closing card states plainly that none of the named speakers exist and nothing quoted happened. Flagged for editorial review before any future use; recommends NOT auto-chaining future render seeds from this episode's own output without a look first. (sess-20260809-1420-e9d3d7f8)
